answer: Trading rights open only after a walked courier bond, not a copied token. The applicant locks 29 coins and carries a one-use packet across three public benches in seed-drawn order. At each bench a clerk loads a sable-hair stamp, presses a ledgered serial onto the flap, and a piezo strip records that press as a ripple trace hashed on-chain. A live vine-fiber band on the flap tears if opened early. Peers re-check the three stamp photos, the piezo hashes, and the intact band. Shared serials or a retaped band burn both bonds, so a thousand sockpuppets require a thousand separate walks.
